messages:
sam: Quick proposal: instead of per-tenant anchors we should try cohort-based 'snooze' windows to smooth migration spikes. idea: group small tenants into cohorts and apply coordinated throttles + billing smoothing.
mina: interesting. cohorts could be by usage band + signup-date. reduces config surface vs one-off anchors.
lee: router change needed? how do we mark cohorted traffic so billing/alerts ignore it appropriately?
tracy: plan: router emits header `X-Redwood-Cohort: <cohort-id>` when a tenant is in snooze. telemetry treats that as a separate stream. billing pipeline gets a rule: exclude cohort-tagged tokens from spike alerts but still count for invoices.
frank: quota interaction: assign each cohort a shared soft-cap (tokens/min + RPS) and a per-tenant subcap. prevents one tenant from hogging the cohort. enforcement at quota layer.
sam: cohort lifecycle: create cohort, enroll tenants (auto by rule or manual), start window (duration configurable), expire & migrate. console should show cohort membership and 'snooze' controls.
mina: UX: migration dashboard needs a cohort view: cohort-id, members, start, expiry, applied-by, cap, percent-used. CS needs revoke-per-tenant ability within cohort.
lee: router pseudocode: if pinned->v1; else if header.v==v2->v2; else if tenant in cohort -> route v1 + inject X-Redwood-Cohort; else -> v2. We should cache cohort membership with TTL to avoid KVS hot paths.
tracy: sampling: 100% cohort traffic for first 48h, then 10%. metrics: cohort-token-delta, cohort-latency, v1-util impact. alerts: cohort-token-delta causes billing-delta>20% OR v1_util>60% => page ops.
frank: autoscaler note: lots of cohort traffic kept on v1 could skew capacity planning. add global-cohort-cap (percent of v1 pool) and a per-rollout override.
sam: rollout: feature flag `cohort-snooze`, canary 1% 2h -> 5% 24h -> ramp. include freeze button if alerts fire.
deploy-bot: PR created: router cohort check + header injection + cohort-service stub + quota caps. Staging smoke ok. Canary scheduled 2024-10-03 08:00 UTC at 1%.
mina: owners: router=lee, cohort-service=frank, telemetry=tracy, console=sam, quotas=frank, runbook=mina. I'll draft runbook with pre/post checks.
lee: I'll add tenant-cohort cache metrics and eviction logs. Also add an admin endpoint to list cohorts and members.
tracy: add dashboard panels and a cohort split in migration graphs. PM wants CSV export for cohort members.
frank: implement soft-shares so cohort capacity is fair. default per-tenant share = min(10% of cohort cap, baseline per-tenant cap).
sam: one more ask: compliance customers need explicit opt-in (no auto-enroll). add policy flag `cohort_auto_enroll` off by default for enterprise orgs.
mina: agreed. will include opt-in policy in the modal and hard reject auto-enroll for enterprise.
lee: PR link posted. Will land behind `cohort-snooze` flag.
frank: I'll wire quota enforcement and the global cap check.
tracy: will wire sampling and alerts pre-canary.
sam: thanks. if anyone objects to cohort defaults speak now, otherwise I'll post runbook link and mock console by EOD.
